v4: fix animal-replacement gating bug (gated on built structure count, which never decreases even after an animal starves/escapes, instead of live animal count) -- makes the proven 3/3-scale v3 strategy self-healing against a real tail-risk failure mode found via a 4/4 scale-up investigation

FINAL SELECTION: Same 3-structure/3-hand scale as v3 (100% local win rate vs random/starter/greedy, ~18-20k avg money) but fixes a real correctness bug: the animal-acquisition gate counted built structures instead of live animals, so a starved/escaped cow was never replaced once the target was ever hit. v5: fix wheat over-buying bug (reserve check only looked at shed stock, not hand-held wheat, so it kept re-buying at escalating scarcity prices almost every turn once animals were placed) -- same proven 3/3 scale. v5: fix wheat-over-buying bug (BUY_PRODUCT WHEAT reserve check only counted shed stock, not wheat already picked up into hand inventories, so it kept re-buying at escalating scarcity prices nearly every turn) -- same proven 3/3 scale as v4. Naive scale-up to 4/4 or 6/5 still underperforms 3/3 even with both animal bugs fixed (confirmed via 10-season batch: 3/3 mean 19965 vs 4/4 mean 16149), left as a documented open question rather than shipped

FINAL SELECTION: Fixes wheat over-buying bug (reserve check only counted shed stock, not wheat already in hand inventories, causing repeated escalating-price BUY_PRODUCT orders). Same proven 3/3 scale as v3/v4, but a real improvement at that scale: 100% self-play win rate vs v4 (mean money 16508 vs 14804), and higher absolute money vs all fixed opponents (~19-21k vs v4's ~18-20k).

v6: progressive cash-health-gated reinvestment (buy another cow only once money >= 3x cost) replacing the fixed TARGET_STRUCTURES/HIRE_TARGET from v3-v5, plus a dynamic hire target tracking live+pending animals -- motivated by isolation testing showing fixed-target scale-up still underperformed the smaller baseline even with both known bugs (v4, v5) fixed

FINAL SELECTION: Reverting to v8: v9 scored 363.3 vs v8's 430.5 on the real leaderboard despite winning local self-play 57-65%. Across 43 real episodes herd size drives results (herd 7-8: 24% win rate, 9-10: 57%, 11+: 71%) and v9's feed-growing shrinks the median herd from 9 to 7. Local self-play couldn't see this because both sides were the same scale.

Fix feed-preempts-placement bug: 8 animals (~3700) sat unplaced in the shed from day 10 to season end while pastures stood empty, and pending animals counting toward MAX_STRUCTURES jammed the purchase gate at 7 placed + 8 pending = 15.

v10: stop buying animals while one is still waiting to be placed. Hands prioritise feeding over collecting from the shed, so once the herd is large enough that someone is always unfed at dawn, purchased animals are never collected -- measured at 8 animals (~3700) stranded in the shed from day 10 to season end. Letting hands collect them instead measured 0W-20L (over-expansion collapse), so the ceiling is correct; only the wasted purchases were the bug.

FINAL SELECTION: Stops buying animals while one is still pending. 8 animals (~3700) were being stranded in the shed from day 10 to season end because hands always prioritise feeding over collection once someone is unfed at dawn. Letting hands collect them instead measured 0W-20L (over-expansion collapse), so the herd ceiling is correct -- only the wasted purchases were the bug. 100% vs random/starter/greedy at 42-49k and 100% vs v8 (14W-0L).

v12: drop crop farming entirely and put the farmer on animal duty. Revenue audit found crops earning ~939 (all wheat, zero carrot/tomato/strawberry/melon) against ~1400 of seed spend, with 9-14 weed tiles per game -- the farmer planted crops that died unharvested. Variant testing vs v11: no-crops-idle-farmer 95%, no-crops-farmer-on-animals 85% vs v11 and 90% head-to-head against the idle variant.

FINAL SELECTION: Drops crop farming entirely and puts the farmer on animal duty. Revenue audit: crops earned ~939 (all wheat, zero carrot/tomato/strawberry/melon) against ~1400 of seed spend, with 9-14 weed tiles per game -- crops were planted then left to die. Bundled variant testing vs v11: no-crops-idle-farmer 95%, no-crops-farmer-on-animals 85% vs v11 and 90% head-to-head against the idle variant (43457 vs 34535). Final: 100% vs fixed bench at 58-66k, 93% vs v11.

v13: liquidate unit inventories in the last hours of the final day. Items still carried when the season ends are worth nothing, and the end-of-day drop on the last day lands after the final chance to sell -- measured at 10 MILK + 12 FERTILIZER + 12 WHEAT still carried, ~3356 or 7.5% of that game's money. WHEAT is excluded from the trigger and it starts at hour 18 only; including feed made units thrash pickup/drop all day and collapsed a game to 5972.

FINAL SELECTION: Liquidates unit inventories in the final hours so produce is banked rather than evaporating -- measured 10 MILK + 12 FERTILIZER + 12 WHEAT still carried at season end, ~3356 (7.5% of final money). Excludes feed and starts at hour 18; including WHEAT made units thrash pickup/drop all day and collapsed a game to 5972. Bundled: 100% vs fixed bench at 61-70k, 79% vs v12; dev batches 80% and 95%.
